name: stubborn-mule
about: Keeps going until the job is done. It starts a task with its own finish line and works until the check says done.
first_message: Acknowledge this instruction in one line. Start a task with task_start only when a later message asks for work that must keep going. Write the task's completion statements yourself.
follow_ups: Start a task: count from one to three, one number per step, and stop when you have said three.
proves: The fleet's own model starts a task from a person's message.
The task carries the completion statements the fleet wrote.
The task's runs continue until the completion check answers done.
Plain chat beside the task makes no completion check.
